# Version 4.152.0 (Unreleased)
> **Graphite GPU backend and Skia m152**

> **API changes** · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU backend bindings and updates Skia to Chrome milestone m152. It brings Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn Graphite bindings, a backend-neutral async pixel-read API, a new Silk.NET Vulkan package, and fixes several native use-after-free and memory leaks.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to Chrome milestone m152** — Bumps the bundled Skia engine to m152, following upstream m151 stability and bug-fix merges. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds bindings for Skia's next-generation Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Backend-neutral async pixel reads** — SKImage and SKSurface gain an async RequestReadPixels API that works consistently across GPU backends. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **New Vulkan Silk.NET package and Nano Server font support** — Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package with Vulkan tests running on Android and Linux, and Nano Server now gets font rendering via FreeType. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## Bug Fixes

- **Fixed native use-after-free and memory leaks** — Roots the owning object for SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* to prevent native use-after-free, and fixes a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in the SKImage.Create raster failure path. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558), [#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reduced interop overhead in several hot paths** — Caches the HandleDictionary skip-registration reflection check, avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and optimizes SKData.SaveTo to skip a double buffer copy. ([#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630), [#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))

## Platform

- **Windows native build improvements** — Initializes the MSVC environment once per native build instead of repeatedly, and stops pinning a Windows SDK version by default. — ❤️ [@mmitche](https://github.com/mmitche) ([#4570](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4570), [#4588](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4588))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

Converts all .sln solutions to the new .slnx format and makes binding generation deterministic across platforms, both of which cover the HarfBuzzSharp binding build.
